title: Start every new page from here
lead: This screen is wired to GET /api/template. Copy the frontend file and the FastAPI page module to add a new route.

steps.title: Copy the frontend page
steps.text: Duplicate src/pages/TemplatePage.jsx, export pageMeta, and keep the useApi hook.

steps.title: Rename the slug
steps.text: Use the same slug in page_meta, the JSON filename, the router prefix, and the fetch path.
